prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: Just to let you know, Kenneth & Dr. Davis were an amazing crew on DL5314 from LGA to CLT this morning!
Delta: Thanks for the compliment for Kenneth and Dr. Davis; we're pretty proud of them too! ✈  *TJP

Customer: Sometimes in Delta comfort we get premium snacks and other times not. Which way is it and would you let your crews know please? 1302
Delta: Hello, Carl. Premium snacks are offered in Delta Comfort Plus seats when the flight travel is more than 900 miles.  Hope this helps! *CAE

Customer: So glad my mum had a fantastic fight with brilliant cabin crew on her  fight from ATL to LHR last night! Said she couldn’t fault them!
Delta: I am so glad to hear this! *TBW

Customer: Yesterday I fly Delta from Cancun Mexico to Boston.  It was originally Aeromexico.  I would like to get credit for the miles on my Skymiles.  Please let me know how I can do this.
Delta: Hi. Happy to help you. May I please have your SkyMiles number in a DM? Also, please give your ticket number for your flight from MEX-BOS as well to create the credit for your flight, thanks.  *ADB https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: rebooking_change):
"""you have changed my fight for the third time and the new times are not acceptable. Please let me know how to amend"""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: We’re sorry for the inconvenience. Please DM us your SkyMiles number, reservation code, and preferred new times so we can assist with rebooking.
